name: Skip Layer Guidance Simple (uncond only)
plain: Does not add a pass. It runs the negative pass with blocks skipped in place of the normal negative pass, so CFG itself carries the perturbation. Cheaper than SLG, but gives no separate scale.
math:
In window: x̂_u = M(x; n) with listed blocks skipped; x̂_c normal; then normal CFG.
Outside window, and at cfg 1: normal batch.

props.extra_model_calls: 0 (two separate calls instead of one batched)
